Hi Marija,

Thank you for coming back to me so quickly.

I have to be straight with you on this one: we are not able to send a refund out in crypto. It is not a payout method we use, and I would rather tell you that now than leave you waiting on something that cannot happen. The money is still yours and still with us, that part is not in question.

That leaves the bank transfer as the realistic route. One thing I noticed on the details you sent: the IBAN is in the name Aleksandr G., which is not the name on the order. That is not a problem in itself, but it does need a colleague to confirm it before anything is sent, since the payout has to be matched to the order properly.

I have passed the whole case to the team with your order, the voided refund from 25 August and your bank's proof. They are offline this evening and pick it up tomorrow at 10am Eastern, and the answer comes straight to you in this thread. Nothing needs to be sent again from your side.

Sorry for how long this has dragged on, Marija. It will be dealt with.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support

Hello,

First of all, my name is Mia, and as we’ve been talking you were naming me Mia in all the emails except for the last 1 or two where your colleague Sarah mistakenly named me Marija. I signed myself as Mia on all my emails and Ive been talking to you and your team through emails and phone calls and iMessage  as Mia for the last 6 months.
Marija was only name on the address where i ordered the minor.
I originally payed w credit card with the name : Aleksandr G. and now i sent you an IBAN and i want the refund to another card BUT Aleksandr G. as well - just another card  (the one that is valid and working)
Obviously your colleague Sarah has been making a lot of mistakes lately starting from her first message where she was telling me how i payed with PayPal account asking me to send her screenshots of my PayPal balance… so much of my time and money you waisted in this situation and now on top of all that u are giving the job to someone new who has no clue of whats going on. How can you give her all the responsibility to solve this problem thats been happening for over 6 months now.
And now you’re telling me send IBAN i sent it, send crypto i sent it then u say no crypto, after you say its not the same name for IBAN when in fact it HAS BEEN the same name this whole time.
Do you understand that you are keeping my money since March ? U have absolutely wasted all of my time and money and energy i had to beg you and your customer service to answer my texts and emails in the last 6 months as if i’m the one owing YOU money.
This has been going on for months and months and i have no more patience.
My original payment has been made with the card Aleksandr G. and now im asking for my refund in the same card name. Right now. Today.
Please solve this as soon as possible i don’t want to be waiting until your team reviews the situation again and again and again its ridiculous at this point.

I made this order in March.

Mia

Hi Mia,

You are right on both counts, and I am sorry. Your name is Mia, Marija is only the name on the delivery address, and the payment and the bank details are both in the name Aleksandr G., exactly as they have been from the start. The P. question earlier in the thread was my mistake too. None of that was your doing, and I understand why six months of this has worn your patience out.

I have made one thing clear and urgent for the team: the crypto payment is on hold and will not be sent. You want the $718.99 on a working card in the name Aleksandr G., and that instruction is now on the file along with the IBAN you sent, so nobody asks you for either of them again.

I cannot move the money myself, and I am not going to pretend otherwise or promise you a time I do not control. It is with Georges and Abel as the first thing on their desk when they are back at 10am Eastern this morning, and the reply comes to you here in this thread.

Again, I am sorry it took this long and this many turns.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
